name: Shimmer Stout
label: Quest
description: Following the creation of his experimental Shimmer Stout in Brewnall Village, Rejold Barleybrew asks travelers to carry a fresh barrel out to his brother…
intro: Following the creation of his experimental Shimmer Stout in Brewnall Village, Rejold Barleybrew asks travelers to carry a fresh barrel out to his brother Wellart. Wellart serves as a dwarf Mountaineer stationed at the southern guard tower guarding the pass toward Loch Modan, where a cold post makes a strong drink all the more welcome.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I'd like my brother Wellart to try my new Shimmer Stout. He's a Mountaineer stationed in the southern guard tower, one of two towers on the border to Loch Modan.
He may not be a brewer like the rest of us Barleybrews, but he loves his drinks and I know he'll like this one.
Can you bring him this Barrel of Shimmer Stout for me?

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hello, adventurer! And what business takes you all the way out here?
Something exciting, I hope. I haven't been in a good fight in days, and this barrel of ale is almost dry...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh. Whoa! This stuff really puts a shine in your eyes. I feel like I can see in the dark!

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
